```swrl
Mission(?m) ^ relatesToIncident(?m, ?i) ^ beAWARE_ontology:hasIncidentPriority(?i, "high") -> hasMissionPriority(?m, "high")
```

This rule states that if there exists a mission (?m) related to an incident (?i), and the priority of the incident is 'high', then the mission should also have a priority of 'high'. The variables used in the conclusion are present in the conditions, each atom has exactly one variable representing a class or concept, and each object property has exactly two variables.
